subject: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep

Team —

We need a clean, board-ready snapshot of ARR, bookings commits, and the narrative that explains the variances since last quarter. The board pack goes to the execs on Friday 8/13; I want the finance-approved numbers and pipeline hygiene locked by EOD Monday 8/9. Specific asks: 

- Vivek: update the commit list (only include deals with sales-engineered legal & PO in progress). Mark true "commit" vs "probable". If you change a deal from commit -> no-commit, add a one-line rationale in the attached commit_change_log.txt.
- Marcus: refresh the pipeline snapshot in the spreadsheet (remove stale opportunities, update stage dates). Focus on ACME-sized deals (> $250k ARR).
- Laura: I need the ARR reconciliation table in Q3_board_metrics_master.xlsx completed — breakdown by new logo, expansion, churn. Reconcile to the GL numbers in the drive link.
- Tessa: build the 1-slide narrative of top 5 wins/losses and anything the board should be aware of on risk. Keep it one slide and 3 bullet takeaways.
- Neha: please run an eyeball QA on the deal-level math and the blended ARR math — highlight any rounding diffs.

Attachments: I attached the current draft workbook (Q3_board_metrics_master.xlsx) and a raw pipeline export (pipeline_snapshot_20260809.csv). I also started a short changelog (commit_change_log.txt) — please append any edits.

Timing: EOD Monday 8/9 for final numbers so we have Tuesday-Wednesday to polish the narrative and create slides. If you anticipate anything blocking the commit list (legal/PO delays, procurement hold), flag it in this thread immediately and @Vivek in Slack.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0194

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep

Thanks Vanessa — starting the commit scrub now. A couple quick flags based on early looks: 

1) ACME AI (DL-2026-0764) is sitting as commit in HubSpot but procurement signoff is pending (final PO expected by 8/12). Recommend tagging as "commit-provisional" and including a one-line note (procurement pending).
2) Two deals in EMEA had pricing objections; I've moved them to "probable" pending discount approvals.

I'll push an updated pipeline CSV by EOD Tuesday and drop a slim commit-only tab in the workbook. If anyone on this thread has had direct procurement conversations, please paste notes here.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep

Uploading a trimmed pipeline snapshot (see pipeline_snapshot_20260804.csv stub in Drive). Notes: 

- Removed 18 stale opps older than 120 days with no activity.
- Moved three opportunities where contract redlines were not accepted back to "no-commit"; logged the reason in commit_change_log.txt.
- Flagging ACME AI: deal size footprint confirmed $310k ARR, discount discussion ongoing. If PO arrives by 8/12, this goes into commit.

I'll sync with finance tomorrow AM to reconcile ARR math before we lock.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Operations
marcus@redwood.inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep

Folks — I've reconciled the ARR table in Q3_board_metrics_master.xlsx and pulled GL-backed numbers for new vs. expansion. Top-line: net ARR is showing +$1.2M QoQ before churn adjustments; bookings-to-ARR conversion assumptions are listed in sheet 'Assumptions'. 

Open items: 
- I see a $48k discrepancy on international tax credits; Neha, can you check the export mapping for the country codes?
- Confirmed that deferred revenue pacing for July was recognized on schedule, no cutover issues.

I've attached a quick one-page note in Drive with the reconciliation steps. If we keep ACME as commit-provisional, I will show it as a footnoted commit in the board pack (not included in ARR run rate unless PO received).

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep

Drafting the one-slide narrative now. Early bullets I'm planning: 

- ARR: +$1.2M QoQ driven by 4 new logo wins and upsells at existing enterprise accounts.
- Risk: three large deals remain "probable" due to commercial/legal timing; ACME AI is the largest conditional item.
- Ops ask: approval to show ACME as provisional commit (footnote + expected PO date 8/12).

I'll aim to circulate a slide PDF Monday AM (8/9) for final sign-off. Marcus — please provide the final commit-only deal list by EOD Monday so I can update the slide.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of FP&A | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Board metrics: revenue narrative & pipeline stage sweep

Final update: 

- I have locked the commit list. 7 deals remain as "commit" totaling $2.9M bookings (Q3 run rate impact: $1.7M ARR). ACME AI (DL-2026-0764) remains listed as provisional — procurement confirmed verbally and PO is in DocuSign (link below).
- Marcus uploaded the final pipeline snapshot and updated commit_change_log.txt with the rationale for changes.
- Laura completed the ARR reconciliation; the net +$1.2M QoQ stands after the adjustments.

Next steps: Vanessa/Tessa, you have the numbers to finalize the board slide. I'll remove the provisional tag once DocuSign is fully executed; procurement@acmeai.com is looping in legal and expects completion by EOD 8/12.

DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ENVELOPE-9987
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/10234/DL-2026-0764
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBoardNarrativeDraft

If anyone sees a material reason to revert a commit, call me directly. Otherwise, lock it and I'll brief the CEO before the board packet goes out.
